message.coraline.parents_no_room: Both parents need clear, solid ground nearby.
tooltip.coraline.midnight_coat: Faster movement and a small jump boost around midnight. See skylit terrain at night, not caves.
tooltip.coraline.star_shirt: Casts a gentle moving light around you while worn.
tooltip.coraline.raincoat: Move much faster while it is raining.
tooltip.coraline.silent_slippers: Makes it harder for mobs to notice you. Does not prevent retaliation.
tooltip.coraline.feather_boots: Drift gently downward and land safely.
tooltip.coraline.set.midnight: Full set: leap very high and fall slowly at night.
tooltip.coraline.set.buttonguard: Reflects some damage back to attackers.
tooltip.coraline.set.midnight_cloak: Full set: greatly reduces normal mob detection at night. Retaliation still applies.
tooltip.coraline.set.luck: Full set: increases loot from defeated mobs.
tooltip.coraline.set.garden_vines: Full set: may poison and slow attackers.
tooltip.coraline.set.moonstone: Full set: gains extra protection at night.
tooltip.coraline.set.miners: Full set: ordinary mined blocks yield extra drops.
tooltip.coraline.midnight_goggles: Night vision while worn, including underground.
tooltip.coraline.set.spidervision: Full set: move quickly through webs. Enemy attacks may create temporary cobwebs.
tooltip.coraline.set.soulbound: Full set: heal when you hit or defeat mobs.
tooltip.coraline.set.super_spidervision: Full set: web speed, defensive webs and slow wall climbing. Hold jump to climb webs or grip a ceiling; sneak to descend or release.
tooltip.coraline.set.soulbound_potent_be: Full set: heal when you hit or defeat mobs.
tooltip.coraline.unbinding_button_eyes: Reveals nearby loaded mobs through walls while worn.
tooltip.coraline.cotton_candy: %s bites remaining. Restores hunger with each bite.
tooltip.coraline.popcorn: Hold right-click to eat continuously. %s servings remaining.
tooltip.coraline.bottomless_candy_bag: Never consumed. Restores hunger with very low saturation.
tooltip.coraline.moonblade: Strikes harder at night, with moonlit glints while held.
tooltip.coraline.spidervision_sword: Successful mob hits create temporary cobwebs in suitable empty space.
tooltip.coraline.thread_whip: Lashes from farther away and pulls mobs toward you. Attack or right-click to use.
item.coraline.character_evil_other_spink: Evil Other Spink Forcible Spawn Egg
tooltip.coraline.other_void_sword: 60 base damage. Heavy strikes, slightly slower than a diamond axe.
tooltip.coraline.other_iron_lockpick: Use the pin game to open designated Other World caches. Successful unlocks wear the pick.
message.coraline.site_cache_locked: Tier %s lock. Use an Other Iron Lockpick.
message.coraline.lockpick_unavailable: This lock cannot be picked from here.
message.coraline.lockpick_worn: The pick needs at least %s durability for this lock.
message.coraline.thread_cutter_required: These supernatural threads need an Other Iron Thread Cutter.
tooltip.coraline.other_iron_thread_cutte: Cuts generated supernatural bindings. Successful cuts cost durability.
message.coraline.rift_security_locked: The security gate needs an Other Iron Lockpick.
message.coraline.rift_disruptor_required: Use an Other Iron Drill Disruptor on this machinery.
message.coraline.rift_sabotage_sequence: Unlock security, disable both conduits, then disrupt the drill.
message.coraline.rift_drill_disabled: The Rift Drill is permanently disabled.
message.coraline.rift_drill_no_fuel: Rift Drill disabled. The Breach Drive had no fuel.
message.coraline.rift_drill_avatar_locke: Rift Drill disabled. Defeat the White Void Avatar before Breach can fall.
tooltip.coraline.other_iron_drill_disrup: Unlock security, sever both power conduits, then sabotage the central drill.
message.coraline.mirror.access: You cannot use this mirror here.
tooltip.coraline.perfect_power: Carry Perfect Essence to empower equipped gear. 1 Essence repairs 10 durability.
tooltip.coraline.perfect_ability: Special ability: 1 Essence. Tools: sneak + right-click; weapons: right-click.
tooltip.coraline.perfect_armor: Full set: press the Perfect Barrier key (default V). Costs 1 Essence.
message.coraline.infinite.unavailable: The passage cannot open safely right now.
message.coraline.infinite.save_paused: The passage is waiting for a safe world save.
message.coraline.infinite.preparing: The passage is opening. Stay nearby.
message.coraline.infinite.arrival_blocke: Clear the arrival frame and its walking space.
message.coraline.infinite.return_blocked: A safe return landing could not be found.
message.coraline.infinite.ending_require: Finish the story and dispose of the key at the Magic Well first.
message.coraline.infinite.portal_reserve: This portal must remain clear for safe travel.
message.coraline.avatar_appeared: A White Void Avatar has manifested near %s, %s.
message.coraline.avatar_defeated: The White Void Avatar has fallen. Breach has receded to 1.5.
message.coraline.seam_unavailable: The seam cannot be operated safely right now.
message.coraline.seam_closed: This dimensional seam is permanently closed.
message.coraline.seam_alignment: Turn each arrow toward its illuminated floor marker, then close the seam here.
message.coraline.seam_contained: Seam closed. Breach reduced by up to 0.15.
message.coraline.seam_closed_no_credit: Seam closed. Containment was unavailable; no later fuel payment is pending.
message.coraline.boundary_complete: The boundary is secure. Its reward cache is open.
message.coraline.boundary_active: Defend the beacon. Keep close until the attackers are defeated or the boundary stabilizes.
message.coraline.boundary_retry: The beacon is recovering. Try again shortly.
message.coraline.boundary_clear_space: Clear the four inner corners of the shrine before starting its defense.
message.coraline.boundary_started: Defend the beacon! Defeat the attackers or hold the boundary for 60 seconds.
message.coraline.boundary_victory: Boundary stabilized. The shrine reward cache is now open.
message.coraline.boundary_failed: The boundary failed. Its reward stays sealed; the beacon will recover.
message.coraline.boundary_reward_sealed: Defend this shrine at its Boundary Beacon to unseal the reward.
message.coraline.resistance_lookout: I'll keep watch. Use the Boundary Beacon when you're ready to defend this sanctuary.
message.coraline.observatory_hint: Stand by the instrument and use a spyglass. Hold your view on each of the four constellation lights for a moment.
message.coraline.observatory_complete: The constellation is charted. The research archive is open.
message.coraline.observatory_reward_seal: Observe the four constellation lights through a spyglass beside this observatory’s instrument.
message.coraline.performance_started: Take your place on the lit mark. At each second chime, jump from that mark. Complete eight phrases to break the repeating script.
message.coraline.performance_active: A performance is in progress. Follow the lit marks and jump at the second chime.
message.coraline.performance_missed: The phrase repeats. Return to the lit mark and jump at the second chime.
message.coraline.performance_complete: The repeating performance has ended. The surviving troupe is free, and the backstage cache is open.
message.coraline.performance_reward_seal: Break this theatre’s repeating performance at its Stage Cue Box to open the backstage cache.
message.coraline.performer_loop: The same steps. The same ending. Please change the performance at the cue box.
message.coraline.performer_freed: The script finally ended. We can choose our own steps again.
message.coraline.carnival_started: Stand behind the yellow firing line and shoot the glowing targets. Eight correct hits in sixty seconds will end the routine. Supplies are in the side booth.
message.coraline.carnival_active: The gallery is running. Shoot the glowing target from the yellow firing lane.
message.coraline.carnival_retry: The gallery is resetting. Ring the bell again in a few seconds.
message.coraline.carnival_timeout: Time is up. The prize stays sealed; the bell will allow another attempt shortly.
message.coraline.carnival_complete: The carnival routine is broken. The surviving performers are free, and the prize cache is open.
message.coraline.carnival_reward_sealed: Break this carnival’s routine at the Gallery Bell to open its prize cache.
message.coraline.carnival_performer_loop: The prizes never change and the targets never stop. Ring the gallery bell. Please end this routine.
message.coraline.orphanage_record_0: Admissions: Every arrival signed the same name. The west ledger lists two inhabitants transferred to the rear cells. Neither signed a release.
message.coraline.orphanage_record_1: Matron’s Orders: Keep the doors bound. The inhabitants are people, not property. Someone crossed out the word “people.” Compare the rear discharge record.
message.coraline.orphanage_record_2: Discharges: The transfers were forged. Neither inhabitant owes the institution a debt. All three records authorize the front-office release register.
message.coraline.orphanage_missing: The release is still blocked. Read the west admissions, east orders, and rear discharge records, then return here.
message.coraline.orphanage_released: The forged custody is ended. The cell bindings dissolve, the surviving inhabitants are free, and the archive is open.
message.coraline.orphanage_reward_sealed: Investigate the three orphanage records and authorize release at the front-office register.
message.coraline.orphan_bound: They keep our names in the records. Find the admissions, orders and discharges. The front register controls these bindings.
message.coraline.orphan_freed: There is a road outside. This time we can choose to follow it.
message.coraline.heart_started: Containment begins. Defeat all eight Rift Soldiers within two minutes while protecting the beacon. Waiting alone cannot close the heart.
message.coraline.heart_timeout: The heart escaped containment. Its reward stays sealed. Clear the chamber before trying again.
message.coraline.heart_victory: The regional heart is contained. The archive is open. A powered Breach Drive receives containment credit once; an empty Drive cannot bank credit for later.
message.coraline.false_palace_sealed: The archive is bound to the Buttonroot Cage. Align the two upstairs dials and the downstairs rear dial with their illuminated floor clues, then operate the anchor beside the cage.
message.coraline.false_palace_opened: The Buttonroot Cage anchors are disconnected. Its bindings and the upper archive are open.
message.coraline.rescue_begins: Coraline: The well did not kill Wybie. Something carried him beyond it. Look for a newly charted Well Scar in front of a false copy of this house. Follow his repaired bicycle parts, not the perfect imitations.
message.coraline.rescue_scar: The Well Scar: white fractures surround a mechanical trail. Read the damaged wheel, the spoke cluster, then the repair pin before investigating the false house.
message.coraline.rescue_clue_0: The wheel is bent, but its repair has Wybie’s uneven left-handed crimp. The same scratch continues toward a cluster of spokes.
message.coraline.rescue_clue_1: The spokes carry the same hand-made repair. A bent pin points into the false house. The polished golden trace points the wrong way.
message.coraline.rescue_clue_2: The repair pin fits his bicycle. This trail is genuine. Search upstairs for the Buttonroot Cage; its anchors connect two upper rooms to the rear room below.
message.coraline.rescue_false_trail: This part is flawless, and its repair is reversed. It is a lure. Follow the damaged iron parts instead.
message.coraline.rescue_trail_order: Read the damaged wheel first, the spoke cluster second, and the repair pin third. Their repairs form one continuous trail.
message.coraline.rescue_no_living_witnes: Coraline: I cannot promise he survived without evidence of his living fall. A recorded death is different from being lost beyond the well.
message.coraline.rescue_loading_original: Coraline: His last known place is still being searched. Speak to me again shortly.
message.coraline.rescue_original_unavail: Coraline: I cannot reach the original Wybie safely right now. I will not replace him with an imitation.
message.coraline.rescue_escort: Wybie: I thought that house would keep me forever. I’ll follow you. Keep the route clear, and bring me close before using the stable return portal.
message.coraline.rescue_clear_route: Wybie cannot find a walking route. Come back and clear the obstacle or lead him around it; he will not teleport past it.
message.coraline.rescue_complete: Coraline: You brought the real Wybie home. His rescue is now preserved for this postgame cycle. He can stay here with us.
message.coraline.rescue_status_search: Coraline: Explore newly generated terrain for a false Pink Palace with a fractured mechanical approach.
message.coraline.rescue_status_trail_one: Follow the damaged wheel at the beginning of the Well Scar.
message.coraline.rescue_status_trail_two: Follow the matching cluster of bent bicycle spokes.
message.coraline.rescue_status_trail_thr: Find the hand-repaired pin at the end of the genuine trail.
message.coraline.rescue_status_cage: Align the three physical anchors, operate the cage control, then speak to the original Wybie inside.
message.coraline.rescue_status_escort: Wybie is following you. Reach the stable return portal together; keep him within four blocks when you leave.
message.coraline.rescue_status_returning: Bring Wybie back to Coraline beside the Breach Drive at Pink Palace, then speak to her with him nearby.
message.coraline.rescue_status_moving: The original Wybie’s transfer is being reconciled from his saved position. No replacement will be created.
message.coraline.rescue_status_failed: The original Wybie has a recorded death. This rescue cannot silently resurrect him.
message.coraline.breach_raid: The Breach opens nearby. Other World invaders are approaching; lowering Breach below 1.0 will force their retreat.
message.coraline.quest_explore: There is more to investigate, but I need a real location for %s. Chart new structures in the Infinite Other World, then come back.
message.coraline.quest_destination: %s — your charted location is %s, %s, %s in the Infinite Other World.
message.coraline.quest_goal_carnival: Break the gallery’s repeating routine: ring its bell and hit all eight glowing targets from the firing lane. Return to Coraline afterward.
message.coraline.quest_goal_orphanage: Read the admissions, orders and discharge records. Use the front-office register to free the trapped inhabitants, then return to Coraline.
message.coraline.quest_goal_theatre: Help the surviving troupe by ending all eight timed stage phrases. Return to Coraline after the performance is broken.
message.coraline.quest_goal_sanctuary: Start the sanctuary beacon’s defense. Protect it through the actual encounter, then tell Coraline what happened.
message.coraline.quest_goal_seam: Investigate the physical seam. Match all three dials to their floor clues and close its core, then return to Wybie.
message.coraline.quest_goal_drill: Infiltrate the drill center. Open security, disrupt both conduits, and disable the real drill core. Return to Wybie.
message.coraline.quest_goal_boundary: Activate the ancient boundary beacon and finish its actual defense. Wybie needs the surviving instrument’s behavior, not a count of ordinary monster kills.
message.coraline.quest_goal_observatory: Use a real spyglass beside the instrument to study all four constellation lights. Return to Wybie when the observatory’s research is complete.
message.coraline.quest_goal_heart_locati: Revisit this charted regional Heart Chamber and examine the actual structure. This is a research site, separate from the true central Heart.
message.coraline.quest_goal_heart: Contain this regional Heart: defeat all eight admitted attackers while protecting its beacon before time expires. Then return to Wybie.
message.coraline.quest_completed: %s is complete. Your field reward is recorded. Containment credit follows the current Breach Drive and Avatar rules.
message.coraline.quest_abandoned: This assignment is set aside. Its world objective is unchanged. Speak again when you want another field assignment.
message.coraline.quest_finished_elsewher: That objective was completed outside this assignment. I will not count it as your field result. Speak again for another charted location.
message.coraline.quest_find_mine: For the next research step, chart a real Soul Glass Mine. We need a genuine supply site before we assemble the components.
message.coraline.quest_components: Bring four ordinary Soul Glass and two ordinary Other Diamonds. I need the real materials for the instrument; keep special named or bound items.
message.coraline.quest_components_receiv: The components are assembled. Our next field step is stabilizing a charted observatory.
message.coraline.quest_reward_space: Make room for the field reward, then speak to me again. Your completed objective is still recorded.
message.coraline.quest_save_paused: Your assignment is safe, but the world’s save could not be confirmed. Reconnect after the save problem is resolved.
message.coraline.quest_warning: Wybie: I think I found a way to destroy the entire Other World entity. But its portals will stop working. Your personal Other World, Soul Farms, workers and orphanage will be reset. Adopted children will leave the Coraline system. Coraline and I will not remain here in the same way, and you will have to start the story again. Learning how is optional and does not reset anything. Are you sure you want the instructions?
message.coraline.quest_keep_exploring: Nothing has been reset. Keep exploring for as long as you want. You can return to this choice later; sneak-interact for another field assignment.
message.coraline.quest_instructions: Wybie: At the central Heart, disable its reality anchors, survive the shifting world, and expose its living core. Entering is your choice. These instructions are preserved, and nothing has been reset. Sneak-interact if you want another ordinary field assignment instead.
message.coraline.quest_goal_tower: Climb the real spiral stair, find a route through the false mirror walls, and stand on the summit landing. Then return to Coraline.
entity.coraline.true_heart: The Heart of the Other World
message.coraline.heart_prepare: Prepare to enter the true Heart (opens the final warning).
message.coraline.heart_global_permission: This ending affects other players’ Coraline progress. A server operator must initiate it after warning everyone.
message.coraline.heart_final_warning: FINAL ENDING — %s Coraline owner records are currently affected. Defeating the manifestation AND breaking its exposed Heart will retire this Infinite Other World and its portals, reset personal worlds, souls, workers, orphanages, adopted children and story/quest progress, and remove postgame NPCs. Ordinary Minecraft builds and inventories remain. Earned Void Hearts remain governed by their original reward records. Learning the method did not start a reset. You can leave the encounter before destroying the core. Confirm only if you accept these consequences.
message.coraline.heart_confirm: I understand — prepare the final encounter
message.coraline.heart_finish_rituals: Finish active Last Thread rituals and claim any reserved Void Heart rewards before committing this ending.
message.coraline.heart_in_use: Another final encounter is already in progress.
message.coraline.heart_world_warning: %s has chosen to enter the final Heart encounter. Breaking its exposed core after victory will reset ALL Coraline progression, including other players’ personal worlds and adopted children. Ordinary Minecraft content remains.
message.coraline.heart_clear_space: The reserved Heart arrival or body space is obstructed. No replacement body has been issued.
message.coraline.heart_entered: The Heart: three reality anchors feed its body. WEST: strike the anchor three times while its top shines white. EAST: follow the three cyan bridge marks outward, then operate the anchor. SOUTH: operate the anchor and survive twenty continuous seconds on its platform; jump when the floor flashes. NORTH: the return arch lets you leave without a reset. The manifestation becomes vulnerable only after all three anchors are disabled.
message.coraline.heart_navigation: East bridge: %s / 3 markers reached. Operate the far anchor after the third.
message.coraline.heart_survival: Remain on the south platform for twenty continuous seconds. Its bright pulses strike the ground; jump to avoid them. Leaving, dying or disconnecting restarts this anchor’s survival interval.
message.coraline.heart_anchor_disabled: A reality anchor has gone dark.
message.coraline.heart_manifested: The reality anchors fail. The central manifestation is vulnerable. Its close-range resonant warning precedes a ground strike; keep moving and jump.
message.coraline.heart_core_exposed: The manifestation has fallen. The central Heart is now exposed. Breaking it commits the complete ending. You may still leave through the north arch instead.
message.coraline.heart_ending_complete: The Heart collapses. The defeated Other World and its portals are retired. Coraline progression has been reset; ordinary Minecraft content and the earned-heart audit ledger remain. The original story can begin again.
message.coraline.heart_body_missing: The manifestation could not be found after its entire native arena loaded. This attempt is paused without granting a victory or a replacement body. Leave through the return arch and speak to Wybie to begin a new attempt.
message.coraline.heart_scope_capacity: The ending has reached its bounded owner-recovery limit. Pending player cleanup must finish before another global ending can be committed.
message.coraline.heart_parents_space: The starting parent setup needs clear standing space beside your existing Parents Bed at %s, %s, %s. Clear the obstruction; the ending recovery will resume without replacing a missing original.
message.coraline.quest_goal_factory: Investigate the clockwork factory. Stop the actual production press: disengage the red workroom clutch, blue hall clutch and green control-room clutch in that order, then switch off the central press. Open its secured archive with an Other Iron Lockpick and read the production orders. Then return to Coraline.
message.coraline.factory_orders: The control archive records batches of artificial workers: bodies assembled to order, assigned to production lines, and replaced when their seams fail. You have uncovered the factory’s purpose.
message.coraline.factory_instructions: This press assembles a batch of three artificial workers. Disengage the RED clutch in the workroom, then the BLUE clutch in the main hall, then the GREEN clutch in the control room. Return here to switch off the press and release the archive lock.
message.coraline.factory_order: The governor holds that clutch shut. Disengage red, then blue, then green.
message.coraline.factory_clutch_off: The clutch disengages. The production press still needs to be switched off.
message.coraline.factory_return_press: All three clutches are disengaged. Return to the central press and switch it off.
message.coraline.factory_stopped: The production line is shut down. Its control-room archive is accessible.
message.coraline.factory_save_paused: The factory record cannot be saved safely. Its machinery and worker identities have been preserved; resolve the world save problem before continuing.
message.coraline.factory_archive_sealed: The production line holds this archive shut. Read the central press and operate its three shutdown clutches first.
message.coraline.quest_world_quiet: Coraline: The boundary is holding for now. There are still people and places worth finding beyond it.
message.coraline.quest_world_raids: Coraline: The breach is open wide enough for raids and infection. Watch the settlements as well as the roads.
message.coraline.quest_world_spreading: Coraline: It is spreading faster now. Closing real seams and machinery matters, but keep the Breach Drive supplied.
message.coraline.quest_world_avatar: Coraline: The boundary has reached its limit. The White Void Avatar crisis must be resolved before ordinary containment can help.
message.coraline.breach_reinforcements: An Infection Heart is calling reinforcements nearby.
